subject: general
question: With which musical instrument was Ali Akbar Khan associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ali Akbar Khan was an Indian Hindustani classical musician of the **Maihar gharana.**
 
• He is known for his virtuosity in playing the **sarod**.
 
• Khan was awarded the **Padma Bhushan in 1967 and the Padma Vibhushan in 1989.**
 
• He received a MacArthur Fellowship in 1991, the first Indian musician to receive the so-called "**genius grant".**
